Resolves #21967

🌿 One spec written against a removed file can no longer stop the whole unit suite before its first test.

#21907 added `Example.spec.mjs` against `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`, and #21856 had already split that file into `apps/portal/resources/data/examples/`. On `dev` (`f4b25a6a9e`) the spec throws while the suite is being collected, so the unit job stops before running anything, on `dev` and on every pull request that takes it in. The spec now reads the records through `readExampleCatalog(EXAMPLES_DIR)` with a top-level await, as `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` does. Its assertions are unchanged.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — one spec's data source, no assertion changed.

Evidence: L2 (the unit tier, local) → L2 required (AC-1, AC-2). Residual: none.
